# Vetta 0.6.30
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### Improvements

- Settings → General → Export diagnostics now opens a guide that lists what's inside and notes Vetta doesn't collect your data. Choose where to save it, then send it to the developers in a GitHub issue or a direct message.

## 中文

### 改进

- 设置 → 通用 → 导出诊断包改为先打开说明：列出包里有什么，说明 Vetta 不收集你的数据；可自选保存位置，再通过 GitHub Issue 或私聊发给开发者。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.29...v0.6.30
